subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: For local workspace avatars that fail policy checks, should OpenClaw keep the fail-closed 404 image route and add clearer metadata/UI diagnostics, or change the HTTP/error contract or size policy?
rationale: The remaining choice affects local file-serving security, existing avatar route semantics, browser UX, and whether oversized files stay blocked, so automation should not silently choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Keep fail-closed and improve diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the 2 MB cap, workspace containment, and 404 image route while making `too_large`, `missing`, and `outside_workspace` visible in WebChat/Control UI and docs.

options.title: Change the route error contract
options.body: Return a more specific HTTP status or machine-readable body for rejected local avatars, accepting any compatibility impact on existing browser/image callers.

options.title: Relax the local size policy
options.body: Allow larger local avatars or configurable limits, accepting the extra memory, bandwidth, and file-serving risk as a product choice.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed and improve diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the 2 MB cap, workspace containment, and 404 image route while making `too_large`, `missing`, and `outside_workspace` visible in WebChat/Control UI and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sits on the avatar feature and security-boundary history most strongly associated with steipete's commits.
